findings.quote: The numerator degree is exactly $1$ greater.
findings.problem: Example 1 requires comparing polynomial degrees, but this part never explains what degree means or identifies a prerequisite that teaches it. Students need that meaning to determine when the slant-asymptote rule applies.
findings.source: Content checklist L25 and lesson-style-guide.md, Teaching completeness: necessary terms require an explanation or an identified prerequisite. [OpenStax Precalculus 2e, Section 3.3](https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/3-3-power-functions-and-polynomial-functions) defines polynomial degree using the highest power with a nonzero coefficient.
